correctness.rationale: Stern pair recursion on F_5²\{0} gives 24 invertible states with transitions L(a,b)=(a,a+b), R(a,b)=(a+b,b). Lexicographic dyadic words concatenate W_{r+1}(v)=W_r(Lv)||W_r(Rv), so total S and extremal prefixes H,J obey exact sum/max/min recurrences. Independently regenerated the simultaneous 24-state identities (S28,H28,J28)=(S16,H16+4,J16−4), 12 base extrema r=8..19 and 8 bridge cases r=8..15. Because recurrence is shift-equivariant with S unchanged, finite identity propagates by induction to every later depth, establishing M_{r+12}=M_r+4, m_{r+12}=m_r−4 for all r≥8. Independently cross-checked 16,384 ordinary Stern prefixes and witnesses at N=2190712 (−6), 8693112 (+12). The limsup and liminf normalized by log₂ N follow from dyadic bounds and actual maximizer/minimizer indices, not a finite scan.
